# webtables/bor

> Bitwise or: `|`, with `i64.or`.

truck [webtables](../webtables.md) · [source](../../../registry/webtables/bor.pkg) · translates [std/bor](../std/bor.md)

    WebAssembly evaluates the operands left to right, as bintables does.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
(i64.or
{left}
{right}
)
```
